report.explanation: All admitted telemetry is healthy: order checkout trace OK at 60ms, error rate 0.0014, p95 74ms, zero db pool waiters and dependency timeouts, and INFO/200 logs across gateway, order, and payment. No current evidence supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate can be stated. Handing off for evidence of actual degradation.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing an actual checkout failure or latency spike (error rate, p95, timeouts) to substantiate the alert
Per-service error/latency breakdown isolating which checkout dependency degraded
Evidence of db pool waiters, dependency timeouts, or 5xx responses to test db-pool-exhaustion or http-500
Memory retention time series per service to test memory-leak
Deployment records correlated with onset to test bad-configuration
